# Know Your Meme

> > A comprehensive database documenting internet memes, viral trends, and digital culture phenomena across platforms like TikTok, Twitter, and YouTube.

Know Your Meme serves as the definitive encyclopedia for internet culture, cataloging the origins, evolution, and spread of memes, viral videos, and online trends. The site features detailed entries on exploitable memes, TikTok trends, catchphrases, and viral moments, providing context and background for understanding contemporary digital communication.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Viral social media moments
- Internet catchphrases
- Dance memes and challenges
- Twitter/X viral content
- DeviantArt and online art communities
- YouTube culture
- Nostalgia memes
- Hood movie references (90s culture)
- Rap song memes
- Instagram viral trends
- Facebook sharing culture

## Meme Entries

- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme entry: viral image of girl/cat from DeviantArt t-a-t-k-a
- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend from BunnaB & YKNiece's Atlanta rap song 'Innit'
